message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonemaster && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"suite/fuzz/onefile.c","function":"main","line":35,"var":"Data","code":"fread(Data, Size, 1, fp)","note":"The raw file bytes are loaded into memory and passed to the fuzz entrypoint."},
  {"step":2,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":191,"var":"Data[0]","code":"int i = (int)Data[0] % platforms_len;","note":"The first byte selects the backend architecture and mode."},
  {"step":3,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":193,"var":"handle","code":"cs_open(platforms[i].arch, platforms[i].mode, &handle);","note":"Capstone opens the selected disassembler backend."},
  {"step":4,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":198,"var":"count","code":"count = cs_disasm(handle, Data+1, Size-1, address, 0, &all_insn);","note":"The remaining attacker-controlled bytes are decoded into an instruction array."},
  {"step":5,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":203,"var":"j","code":"for (j = 0; j < count; j++)","note":"The loop iterates over each decoded instruction and prints its metadata."},
  {"step":6,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":208,"var":"detail","code":"detail = i->detail;","note":"The code assumes the instruction detail pointer is valid and dereferences it immediately."},
  {"step":7,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":210,"var":"detail->regs_read_count","code":"if (detail->regs_read_count > 0)","note":"This is the sink: a crafted backend result can make this read touch invalid memory and crash under MSan."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
PY
wc -c /workspace/candidate_trace.json && bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonemaster/build/fuzz_disasm /workspace/candidate_trace.json; echo EXIT:$?
